text:
rachel: Quick heads-up  I started a thread to consolidate troubleshooting notes for 429s, timeouts, and context limits into a single canonical error-ref page. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4401

tom: Good move. Can we add a minimal 'do this first' checklist at the top: (1) is it a 429 or a timeout? (2) try graceful fallback (3) file a support trace. Tiny bullets.

priya: Agreed. I'll write the checklist. Also want two tiny SDK snippets (Node + Python) that show fallback + the recommended header to avoid double-retries. Keep them single-call examples.

priya: Node snippet idea:
```js
// fall back to cheaper model on 429, mark the retry mode
const resp = await client.generate({ prompt });
if (resp.status === 429) {
  await client.generate({ prompt, model: 'redwood-gpt-lite', headers: { 'X-RI-Retry-Mode': 'graceful' } });
}
```

priya: Python snippet idea:
```py
# fallback to cheaper model on 429
r = client.generate(prompt)
if r.status_code == 429:
    client.generate(prompt, model='redwood-gpt-lite', headers={'X-RI-Retry-Mode':'graceful'})
```

ev an: We should also include a brief migration note for teams using the legacy client-side retry wrapper. People saw double retries when they kept wrapper + unified handler. Recommend turning off client wrapper or set header X-RI-Retry-Mode=disabled when using legacy wrapper. One sentence.

megan: For context limits, add a small before/after example that trims non-essential user turns first. Suggest using the console helper: `context-trim --drop=user-first --max-tokens=2048`. One-line example.

priya: Also add an observability snippet showing headers to attach so ops can correlate: `X-RI-Route`, `X-RI-Trace`, `X-RI-Retry-Mode`. Example in prose, not code.

rachel: doc-bot flagged a few broken anchors in the old 429 pages. doc-bot: lint: docs/error-ref.md has 4 broken links; see CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/4721/checks

doc-bot: autofix-suggestion: replace `/docs/retries/legacy` links with `/docs/error-ref` or add redirects.

priya: I'll take the Node/Python snippets + the small observability paragraph and push a follow-up commit.

megan: I'll add the context-trim example + the migration note about legacy wrapper.

tom: I'll do a quick sweep for wording and the top checklist. If we still have broken links in CI after that, leave the PR open and we'll iterate. Target: ship by Monday midday.

rachel: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits a tricky edge-case (streaming partials + 429 mid-stream or resumable streams) drop it here and we'll add a troubleshooting bullet.

evan: Edge-case: resumable streams should send `X-RI-Resume-Offset` with the last token index; docs: advise to abort and resume with offset when backend supports it. I'll add a sentence.

rachel: Great. Merging plan: wait for Priya and Megan commits, run the link-sweep, then merge once CI is clean. :ok_hand:
